card.name: Words right before 'fund' or 'funded'
card.fires_on: The word just before a form of fund or pay for, when a sponsor or agency is named as paying for research or a program. It fires on helpers like was, is, helps, and, or on an agency name.

modes.label: Helper verb before funded
modes.description: A small verb such as was, is, helps or has just before funded or fund.
modes.example: The research<< was>> funded by the National Institutes of Health,

modes.label: Funder name or modifier
modes.description: The last word of an agency name or a word like federal, right before funds or funded.
modes.example: programs receiving<< federal>> funds make their facilities accessible.
